title: Here’s Your Sign to Avoid Dr*gs at All Costs
description:
According to the 2023 United States National Survey on Drug Use and Health 48.5 million Americans aged 12 and older battled a substance use disorder in the past year. That addiction lands a staggering number of people in the street whose lives often devolve to petty crimes and general public nuisance. The female’s body was twitching and she couldn’t even stand straight for a moment. It was quite obvious that she was tweaking but the officers were yet to find a strong probable cause as they had not witnessed her breaking in or chasing someone with a bat. The female was in no condition to be left by herself so the officers decided it was best to intervene and try to get her some help. The female wasn’t done resisting and she made sure that the officers had the toughest time carrying her into the hospital. It should be acknowledged that the first step towards recovery is accepting that you need help and the least you can do is not hinder the people trying to help you. The 22 year old female was charged with public nuisance and resisting arrest.

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
